gaps.description: The durable catalog contains Google, Black Forest Labs and Runway facts from NODE-07, but execution adapters for those providers are not implemented in NODE-22/23. Registry-first routing fails them closed as adapter_unavailable instead of pretending they are callable.

NODE-07 seed intentionally has no LUMI live benchmark scores. Routing profile evaluation therefore returns insufficient_evidence rather than inventing quality winners until versioned benchmark runs are published.

Versioned refresh and in-process snapshot replacement are implemented, but a broker-level registry-version invalidation event is not added to the frozen NODE-12 v1 event set. Multi-process propagation remains a composition step.
Immutable snapshot schema and deterministic publisher exist, but the production admin approval/change-review UI/API and audit workflow for publishing new registry versions are not composed.
PostgreSQL verification and seed tools use asyncpg through ephemeral CI dependencies; asyncpg is not added as a frozen Model Gateway runtime dependency in this connector-only environment.
NODE-22 MODEL-PACKAGE-008 remains open: the formal standalone lumi-api -> lumi-model-gateway workspace dependency and reviewed uv.lock regeneration are not claimed complete.
Hosted GitHub Actions cannot be treated as PASS while account payment/spending-limit state prevents runner allocation.
